events: nested replacement-created token and counter events
state_reads: active face Oracle text and explicit entry override
state_writes: transformed zone destination and post-move counter intents
choices: affected player or affected object's controller selects between competing represented replacements
hidden_information: seat choice packets omit authoritative event payloads, event paths, batch IDs, and hidden library order
apnap: simultaneous different-seat replacement choices use the shared APNAP batch traversal
replacement_effects: nested event and entry reservation substrate
copy: active copied characteristics can supply the entry text
control_change: entry controller does not alter the unconditional result
zone_change: represented destination changes resolve before the authoritative move
simultaneous moves prepare all replacements against one pre-move source snapshot
source_leaves: a source leaving in the same batch retains its pre-move controller and active-zone facts for every simultaneous event

implementation.component: replacement_effects event substrate, token_creation mutation owner, semantic_runtime token and zone handlers, and CommanderEngine compatibility adapters

known_blockers: conditional entry replacements remain in dedicated handlers or require arbitration
generic affected-subject ordering is not wired into every replaceable event producer
counter-placement replacement producers are not yet integrated
entry reservation scope is not yet connected to general as-enters choices
copy-token entry text is not yet evaluated through move_card
skip, regeneration, redirection, linked exile, and can't-event grammar are not generic
draw replacement paths remain dedicated and commander-zone movement is not yet on the shared boundary
